children: According to the announcement from Binance, Binance Wallet will discontinue support for the Blast chain effective from 2026-11-30 10:00 (UTC). After that time, users will no longer be able to view, send, or receive Blast assets within Binance Wallet. Binance said the change applies only to the display and management of Blast assets in the wallet and does not affect other blockchains supported by Binance Wallet. Users are advised to manage or transfer their Blast assets before 2026-11-30 10:00 (UTC). After Binance Wallet ends support, users may continue claiming their Blast assets through Blast’s official site, provided its Blast Fund Recovery service is functioning. The announcement also says that following the shutdown of the Blast chain, balances displayed in Binance Wallet may not be accurate, and directs users to Blast’s official site for more information. In short, the announced change affects wallet-based viewing and transactions for Blast assets; claiming them remains possible separately through Blast’s site, subject to the stated condition. Binance recommends completing any desired management or transfers before the support discontinuation takes effect.

title: Binance Wallet Will Discontinue Support for Blast
